recognize_zh: 低倍下淋巴結結構保留，但有數個特別大、邊界不清的濾泡；免疫染色可見外套區小淋巴球長入並把生發中心切成碎塊，生發中心標記只剩散在的小群聚，這種結構符合生發中心進行性轉化（PTGC）。
features: Preserved nodal architecture with a few markedly enlarged, expansile follicles several times the size of adjacent reactive follicles
Blurred follicle borders on H&E with small mantle-type lymphocytes infiltrating the follicle
IHC highlights mantle-zone B cells extending into and replacing the follicle center
Germinal-center cells reduced to scattered, fragmented clusters within the enlarged follicle
Interfollicular T-zone and smaller secondary follicles with intact germinal centers and mantle zones nearby
No diffuse effacement or monotonous neoplastic nodules evident at this power
describe_en: Sections of the lymph node show preserved architecture with reactive-appearing secondary follicles and several markedly enlarged follicles with indistinct borders. On immunohistochemistry, small mantle-zone B cells extend into these follicles and break the germinal centers into small, irregular residual clusters, while the adjacent smaller follicles retain normal germinal centers with intact mantle cuffs. The interfollicular T-zone is preserved. The stains are not labeled in these images, and the fragments of germinal-center cells are best seen on the nuclear stains. Large atypical lymphocyte-predominant cells cannot be evaluated at this magnification. Findings are consistent with progressive transformation of germinal centers.

ddx.vs: NLPHL nodules efface the architecture and contain scattered large CD20+/OCT2+ LP (popcorn) cells rimmed by PD-1+ T cells, whereas PTGC has preserved architecture, lacks LP cells, and shows an even distribution of follicular helper T cells.
Hyperplastic follicles keep sharp germinal centers with polarization, tingible-body macrophages and a crisp mantle cuff, without mantle-cell ingrowth fragmenting the follicle center.

FL shows back-to-back monotonous follicles lacking polarization and mantle zones, with BCL2-positive germinal-center cells, rather than few enlarged follicles containing BCL2-negative germinal-center fragments.

ddx.dx: Mantle cell lymphoma, mantle zone or nodular pattern
ddx.vs: MCL is a monotonous cyclin D1+/SOX11+, CD5+ B-cell proliferation expanding the mantles, whereas the ingrowing mantle cells in PTGC are polytypic, IgD+ and cyclin D1-negative.
